resources.string: accusative
Accusative form of a word
plural
Plural form of a word
diminutive
Diminutive form of a noun
directional
An adverb in accusative case indicates direction\nkie: where\nkien: to where
locational

A noun becoming an adverb indicates location
surpinto : peak, tip, top
surpinte: at the peak, at the tip, at the top
ĉambro : room
ĉambre: at the room, in the room
adjectival
Adjectival form of a noun
Adverbial form of an adjective
Adverbial form of a verb
Suffix which turns a word into a place designed for that specific thing\nkafo: coffee\nkafejo: café
Suffix which turns a word into a place designed for that specific action\nkuiri: to cook\nkuirejo: kitchen

Suffix which turns a word into a box or container for that specific thing
abelo: a bee
abelujo: a beehive

Suffix which turns a word into a place where a type of people can be found
patro: father
patrujo: fatherland

Suffix which turns a flower or fruit into a plant or tree which the flower or fruit can be found in
pomo: an apple
pomujo: an apple tree
Suffix which turns a descriptive word into a box or container for that specific type of thing\nfrida: cold\nfridujo: a refrigerator
Suffix which turns an action into a box or container for that specific type of activity\nlavi: to wash\nlavujo: a sink
Suffix which shows possibility\nkompreni: to understand\nkomprenebla: understandable

Suffix which turns an action into a thing representing the action
vivi: to live
vivado: life
spiri: to breathe
spirado: respiration
Prefix which turns an action, description, thing, or direction into its opposite meaning
Prefix meaning to do the action together with other people\nlabori: to work\nkunlabori: to collaborate
Prefix meaning \"outside of\"\nlando: country\neksterlando: foreign country
Prefix meaning to begin the action\nkanti: to sing\nekkanti: to begin to sing
Prefix meaning something is newly or recently done\nvekita: awakened\nĵusvekita: newly/recently awakened

Prefix meaning to do the action in an outward direction
tiri: to pull
eltiri: to pull out

Prefix meaning to do the action all the way to completion
trinki: to drink
eltrinki: to drink up, to drink all of something
lerni: to learn
ellerni: to learn all that you can, to master
uzi: to use
eluzi: to use up, wear out

Prefix meaning "separation, being apart, spreading out"
ŝvebi: to float
disŝvebi: to float out/separately
fali: to fall
disfali: to fall apart
doni: to give
disdoni: to give out, to distribute
sendo: a thing that is sent
dissendo: a broadcast

Prefix meaning "movement to a far distance"
flugi: to fly
forflugi: to fly away

Prefix meaning "disappearance/annihilation"
uzi: to use
foruzi: to use up (until nothing is left)

Prefix meaning "wrong, erroneous"
kompreni: to understand
miskompreni: to misunderstand
paroli: to speak
misparoli: to misspeak
